title: Improve conditional kappa to 0.001715599770234969498857 with concentrated source-partner assignments
body:
## Result

Proposes **conditional κ = 0.001715599770234969498857**, about **0.05829% above PR2673's outer κ** and **2.5671% above the selected PR1094 point**. The selected record is unchanged.

The new construction assigns all eight recovered source-partner lenders jointly to later helper roles. Their target corrections avoid four centre readouts, replacing four charged `7+1` paths with rank `8`. Savings in A are exactly repaid in B; the **complete local delta is `4(H8−H7−H1)` per call**, with every correction, restoration and cleanup cost included. Both providers retain 422 helpers, 78 private zero buffers and rank mass 5,251.

This composes with Jeremy Kothe's PR2673 order/fill through an explicit width-preserving helper permutation. The source order, physical ownership and occupied intervals are preserved. Across 666 calls, the complete delta against PR2673 is exactly **`2664(H8−H7−H1)`**. Subadditivity proves it favorable for every `0<p<1`; no packing improvement beyond PR2673 is claimed.

The directed complex-root bracket is

```
0.001715599770234969498858 < root < 0.001715599770234969498859.
```

The published rational lies below the separately checked outer witness. Complete profile: `{1:1595736,2:420912,3:218382,4:79920,5:17870,7:2664,8:2664,32:1,48:26558}`. Physical stock is 66,814; full rank mass is 4,816,512. The fixed-profile packing relaxation has upper endpoint `.001744165345454`; this is not an attainable-optimum claim.

`PROOF.md` supplies exact source-recovery identities, two correction matrices, the twelve target levels, full section costs, inverse-buffer cleanup and the actual helper-slot bijection. These are arbitrary-input symbolic statements, not tests through a finite bit length. The inherited all-size compiler, common-label/mutable-source realization, physical hosting, precision/tape, exact recovery, analytic transfer, recurrence and bit H1–H5 premises remain conditional. This is an incremental conditional improvement, not an unconditional multiplication theorem or practical speed measurement.

## Validation

The complete fresh public `full_replay.py` passed: source authentication; reproduction of PR2530 and PR2588 words; regeneration and complete-payload binding of both candidates; a fresh PR2588 release; both changed native/phase pipelines; word rebuild and local controls; rebind/Lemma G; strict whole-owner/global invoice; geometry controls; 63 exact outer inequalities, independent balance derivation and 19 inherited outer replays.

A separate standard-library checker verifies all 646 independent input columns in both orientations for both providers, every frame and the 4,529-event cleanup, every owner role against reconstructed strict windows/families/prefixes, and a rational moment bracket. Six mathematical mutation controls and ten evidence-integrity controls reject. Source/word/hosting corruption, optimized-Python rejection, output preservation and Git-free read-only replay were also checked. `VALIDATION.md` records commands, environments and retained receipts.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/t74-concentrated-source-partners
```

This bounded command checks mathematics and retained full-replay bindings. README gives the separate complete fresh command; that command accepts no baseline/native cache. `admit.py` is an internal stage.

Two inherited negative-test adaptations retain their original failures: the old target swap became an identity between equal additions, so its replacement uses distinct sources and has an explicitly nonzero residual; a target-frame mutant correctly rejected but needed its expected error string updated. No mathematical acceptance check was weakened. Maintainer-selected cold replay and formal proof of the full multiplication theorem are not claimed; the applicable pending PR2588-to-candidate chain was replayed.

## Provenance and scope

Explicit donor assignment to improve κ after reviewing recent results; refined `complex-new-helper-inventory` scope. Scientific base `0fdd7d82`, branch base `1884c509`, priority revision 5. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2612). Exact main dependencies: PR2462 `ef34071f`, PR2530 `b4012098`, PR2588 `8cd9dc88`, PR2673 `45aadf0f`. PR2673's outer claim is the numerical comparison; its smaller historical supplier-only `CLAIM.json` is not.

All 292 recent PR bodies through 2689 were read across the research and submission snapshots. The final refresh found PR2679’s distinct 415-helper claim, κ≈0.0017148565406944334; the present point is also about 0.04334% above that claim. PR2679 itself was not independently replayed. Main advanced to `06164c03` without changing the selected record, pinned inputs or applicable T74 guidance. Relevant exact dependencies were inspected and replayed. `RECENT-RESULTS.md`, `TASK.json` and retained review records describe coverage and limits. No unpublished-work or exhaustive novelty claim is made.

Prepared by Mason Hale with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in derivation, implementation, checking and writing, including separate agent reviews; no independent human review. Credit zxv/2530 for source-partner recovery, tekuuu/2436 for lifted targets, Jeremy Kothe/2462/2588/2673 for words, replay and hosting, themilkman216/2621 for the priority-order idea, Philippe Van Velzen/2559 for evacuation, Rohan Arun's owner work, and the retained native/bit/outer lineage. Raw source bytes and notices are preserved; new work is Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

Can a different exact assignment remove the four remaining centre splits? Derive a full compensated candidate or a target-support obstruction first. Can another strict whole-role exchange improve the final fill? Check its complete windows, families and prefixes before expanding a search. Scoped follow-ups and blockers are in `TASK.json`; no search completeness is claimed.

Only `research/t74-concentrated-source-partners/` is added.
